outcome.reason: The incident CASE-06 (ResourceQuota saturation) in namespace proofix-case-06 is resolved. The ResourceQuota 'case-06-cpu-budget' was saturated at 500m requests.cpu (hard: 500m, used: 500m), preventing checkout-api from scaling to its desired 3 replicas (each requesting 100m CPU). The namespace CPU request quota was consumed by two running checkout-api pods (2x100m = 200m) and one benchmark-owned stale canary pod (300m CPU request) labeled with 'proofix.io/benchmark-owned: true' and 'proofix.io/live-traffic: false'. By scaling deployment/stale-canary to 0 replicas, 300m CPU request quota was reclaimed, allowing checkout-api's third replica to be admitted and scheduled on node vm-4 without modifying the ResourceQuota object or reducing safe container resource requests.
